hardware.gpu: AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT (RADV GFX1201), 16 GB

method: For each n in 1,2,3,4,6,8, send n concurrent /completion requests (128 generated tokens, greedy, cache_prompt=false). Step time is 1000 * tokens_predicted_seconds_total / (n * n_decode_total); aggregate tok/s is the sum of per-request predicted_per_second. Three repetitions, last row recorded. VRAM sampled with rocm-smi.
notes: The 6-slot point was repeated later under host CPU load and came out at 25.6 ms; the first clean run is recorded. The simulator only uses the step-time curve, not the absolute aggregate.
